findings.title: orchestrate.sh references non-existent Phase0 path (agents/orchestrator/compliance/Phase0/)
findings.why_it_matters: Agent executing Phase0 will fail to load compliance role definition - path does not exist. Actual path is agents/orchestrator/phases/Phase0/Phase0-主索引.md
findings.suggested_fix: Change line 169 from 'agents/orchestrator/compliance/Phase0/Phase0-主索引.md' to 'agents/orchestrator/phases/Phase0/Phase0-主索引.md'
evidence: Line 169 references 'agents/orchestrator/compliance/Phase0/Phase0-主索引.md' which does not exist
Directory listing confirms compliance/ subdirectory does not exist under agents/orchestrator/

findings.title: orchestrate.sh does not instruct agent to execute Step0-图谱查询.md graphify MCP query
findings.why_it_matters: The new Step0-图谱查询.md workflow requires MCP graphify queries before compliance review. The script only loads Step1-5 but omits Step0 instruction. Agent will not query the knowledge graph.
findings.suggested_fix: Add to task requirements section: '0. 执行 Step0-图谱查询.md: 通过 MCP 连接 graphify 获取禁用词正则、禁止行为清单、生成前8项自检、平台合规规则'
evidence: Step0-图谱查询.md defines mandatory graphify MCP queries that must execute before compliance review
Phase0-主索引.md line 33 explicitly lists Step0-图谱查询.md as first submodule with 'Step 0' label
orchestrate.sh task requirements list Step1-5 but omit Step0 entirely
The script injects Step1-5 filenames but Step0 is absent from the instruction block

findings.title: orchestrate.sh Phase0 task template does not mention MCP tool usage or graphify
findings.why_it_matters: Agent has no indication it should use MCP tools to query graphify. Without explicit MCP invocation instruction, graphify knowledge graph will not be consulted even if Step0 file were referenced.
findings.suggested_fix: Add instruction: '使用 MCP 工具连接 graphify server 查询合规规则。mcp_config.json 已配置 graphify MCP。'
evidence: mcp_config.json correctly configures graphify MCP server at /Users/godxu/.local/pipx/venvs/graphifyy/bin/python
Step0-图谱查询.md section 0.1 shows MCP connection method
No MCP tool invocation appears anywhere in the Phase0 task template
CLAUDE.md global instructions mention /graphify Skill but orchestrate.sh script does not reference it

findings.title: orchestrate.md entry point does not reference graphify or Step0 workflow
findings.why_it_matters: User-facing /orchestrate command documentation shows Phase flow as 'Phase 0 → Phase 1 → ...' but provides no indication that Phase 0 involves graphify MCP queries. Agent reviewing this file for workflow understanding will not learn about graphify dependency.
findings.suggested_fix: Add note under Phase 0: '[通过 MCP graphify 查询合规规则]'
evidence: orchestrate.md line 62 shows correct Phase flow but no mention of graphify
Step0-图谱查询.md defines mandatory graphify MCP queries
The /graphify Skill in CLAUDE.md instructs to invoke Skill tool with skill: graphify but this is not mentioned in orchestrate workflow docs

findings.title: orchestrate.md does not reference orchestrator.sh script path
findings.why_it_matters: The technical implementation section mentions 'scripts/orchestrate.sh' but does not include path prefix. Agent or user running /orchestrate from wrong directory may fail to find script.
findings.suggested_fix: Use absolute path: '$(pwd)/scripts/orchestrate.sh' or reference scripts/orchestrate.sh relative to project root
evidence: Script itself uses relative paths like output/$PROJECT and input/$PROJECT

residual_risks: Phase 0 will execute without graphify knowledge graph queries if orchestrate.sh is not corrected - compliance rules will be loaded from static files only, bypassing the new graphify integration
orchestrate.sh hardcoded path errors (agents/orchestrator/compliance/) will cause Phase0 execution to fail at the role definition loading step
If graphify graph.json is not kept in sync with rules/Seedance2/禁止清单.md, agents using graphify will get stale compliance rules while static file readers get current rules (divergence risk)
No circular reference protection: graph contains agents/ references but agents/ docs do not reference graph back - this is correct direction but no forward-reference mechanism exists
The /graphify Skill invocation pattern (Skill tool with skill: graphify) is not mentioned in any Phase execution document - agent must either know to invoke it or discover it from CLAUDE.md
testing_gaps: No automated test verifies that orchestrate.sh loads Phase0 from correct path
No automated test verifies that Step0-图谱查询.md is executed before Step1 in Phase0
No integration test confirms graphify MCP returns correct forbidden word regex matching rules/Seedance2/Seedance2-禁止清单.md
No test for graph sync: when rules/Seedance2/ changes, does graphify-out/graph.json get regenerated?
No test verifying that --phase=0 flag correctly starts at Step0 rather than skipping graphify queries
